review_note: Golden-hour steps drafted from public law and national practice. Must be reviewed by the state police and the Directorate of Prosecution before use. Minutes count from the time the information was received.

cyber_financial_fraud.label: Online financial fraud (money lost through UPI, card, bank or app)

steps.text: Report the transactions on the national cyber crime helpline 1930 or the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, so the banks can hold the money
steps.basis: MHA I4C Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting and Management System

steps.text: Write down every transaction: date and time, amount, UTR or reference number, bank or wallet, and the account or UPI ID it went to
Ask the complainant to keep the phone, messages, call log and screenshots and not to delete anything
The information is recorded by a woman police officer or a woman officer is present
Keep the victim's name and identity out of every paper that leaves the case file
Medical examination of the victim by a registered medical practitioner, with consent, within 24 hours of the information
If the victim is a child: report to the Child Welfare Committee and the Special Court within 24 hours
Take the survivor at once to the nearest hospital, public or private: first aid and treatment are free and may not be refused
Keep the survivor's name and identity out of every paper that leaves the case file
steps.basis: Masked like BNS 72 (project decision of 2 Nov 2026)

steps.text: Ask the hospital for the injury report (MLC) with the nature of the burns
Seize the container, the survivor's clothes and samples from the place for the forensic lab
Tell the survivor about victim compensation through the District Legal Services Authority
Send the injured person for treatment and medical examination; ask for the injury report (MLC)
Note and keep any weapon or object used, and the clothes with stains, for seizure
Register an FIR for a missing child at once; do not wait
steps.basis: Supreme Court, Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India (2013)

steps.text: Send the photograph and description to neighbouring police stations, railway police and the missing-persons portal
Alert neighbouring police stations and check posts with the registration number, make and colour
Note the chassis and engine numbers from the registration certificate
